   - **Scientific Verdict:** `SUPPORTED_WITH_BOUNDS`
   - **Placement:** **Main text (2–3 sentences)** in the *Thermoplasmatota* subsection of [main.tex](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/main.tex#L239-L279) + **Supplement** for full 7-model tables, $\lambda$ profile likelihood, and comparator diagnostics.
   - **Key Findings & Required Repair:**
     - **Major documentation defect (`H1-MAJ-1`):** While [v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_final/results/v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv) and [DOSSIER.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_final/DOSSIER.md#L71-L86) are exact, Section 4 of the Round 7 file [H1_COMPLETENESS.md](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h2_initial/H1_COMPLETENESS.md#L68-L79) fabricates/corrupts the entire `OLS (lambda = 0)` column and three `PGLS` rows (`Intercept`, `completeness`, `contamination`; e.g., reporting PGLS `completeness` $p = 0.8066$ instead of $p = 0.00840$, and OLS $\hat{\sigma}^2_{\mathrm{unb}} = 0.00108991$ instead of $0.00071159$). Regenerate Section 4 directly from [v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round6/snapshots/h1_final/results/v3_pgls_model_summary.tsv).
     - **Bounds:** The $n = 237$ species are a complete finite cohort (Student-$t$ intervals are model-based superpopulation quantities conditional on fixed `thermo_tree.nwk`); the positive partial slope on AAI ($\hat{\beta}_{\mathrm{AAI}} = +0.001704 \pm 0.000407, p = 4.07 \times 10^{-5}$) is conditional on holding RBH overlap ($\hat{\beta}_{\mathrm{RBH}} = -0.137484 \pm 0.019456, p = 1.88 \times 10^{-11}$) and genome length constant (marginal $r(\text{AAI}, f_{\text{novel}}) = -0.088$); nearest comparators map to 32 unique uncultured GTDB/MGnify MAGs; and 5 genomes lack CheckM2 `.faa` files in $S7$ ($n = 232$).

2. **H2 ([h2_initial](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-2026-10-13/round7/snapshots/h2_initial))**
   - **Execution Status:** `COMPLETE` (Slurm job `53738443`, exit `0:0`; 26/26 snapshot and 13/13 output SHA-256 matches; full Gate 3 census of $1,461$ multi-species families and $7,604$ member rows across $2,126$ bins).
   - **Scientific Verdict:** `SUPPORTED_WITH_BOUNDS`
   - **Placement:** **Main text (1–2 sentences)** in the structural dark proteome subsection of [main.tex](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/main.tex#L281-L319) + **Supplement** for the $2,838 \to 1,461 \to 353$ attrition funnel, common-support strata, matching, and regressions.
   - **Key Findings & Bounds:**
     - **Within-arm enrichment vs between-arm null:** Among the 353 Tier 1 complete-window families, both $K$ ($40.46\%$ vs $8.71\%$ positional expectation, $p = 0.0002$) and $Q\setminus K$ ($32.22\%$ vs $6.56\%$, $p = 0.0002$) show strong non-mobilome flanking KO synteny, but the between-arm difference is null after conditioning on species breadth, coarse phylum group, and flanking KO annotation density ($\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.0354, p = 0.4069$ in Tier 1; $\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}}(E_{\mathrm{fam}}) = +0.0184, p = 0.5618$ in Tier 2; $0.0000$ raw difference, $p = 1.0000$, and $-0.0054$ excess difference, $p = 0.9226$, in strict 96-pair exact-phylum/tight-length matching; OLS/HC3 $\hat{\beta}_{\mathrm{is\_k}} = +0.0294 \pm 0.0430, p = 0.4930$).
     - **Attrition & Tier 3 confounding (`H2-MAJ-1`, `H2-MAJ-2`):** $75.84\%$ ($1,108 / 1,461$) of Gate 3 families fail the primary 4-flank complete-window gate, with differential survival ($30.35\%$ in $K$ vs $20.20\%$ in $Q\setminus K$, Fisher $p = 1.15 \times 10^{-5}$) driven by higher baseline species counts and contig lengths in $K$. The unadjusted Tier 3 partial-window comparison ($33.59\%$ vs $24.66\%, p = 0.000458$) lacks a positional null and is confounded by unequal callable flanks per locus ($2.80$ vs $2.71$) and species breadth ($3.22$ vs $2.91$), and must not be cited as a true conservation advantage for $K$.
